comment: Theming Phase 2b: the generated sandbox scaffold now imports @fluentui/react-tailwind-theme/styles.css and wraps the exported story in <FluentProvider themeClassName={webLightThemeClassName}> using the shipped theme class-name constants, instead of passing a theme object to the removed theme prop. @fluentui/react-tailwind-theme is added to the generated sandbox's dependencies so the theme CSS resolves.
